jobs.title: Software Deployment Engineer
jobs.desc: About KPI Solutions KPI Solutions is a national supply chain consulting and warehouse automation systems integrator, helping some of the biggest names in e-commerce, retail, and distribution move product faster and smarter. Formed in 2021 through the combination of Kuecker Logistics Group, PULSE Integration, and QC Software, KPI brings together decades of material handling and systems integration experience â rooted in material handling integration dating back to 1971. From initial design through go-live and ongoing support, KPI delivers engineered solutions that blend automated technologies (MHE, robotics, conveyor, ASRS, AMR/AGV) with intelligent warehouse execution software to optimize productivity, increase fulfillment speed, and build operational resilience for clients. Position SummaryÂ The Software Deployment Engineer I/II is an individual-contributor role responsible for the end-to-end delivery, configuration, installation, and support of Kommand warehouse execution/control systems and related material handling hardware (pick-to-light, overhead illuminators, AutoStore, and T-sort integrations). This role owns project-level system configuration, commissioning, installation, upgrade, and live troubleshooting work independently, with minimal oversight, across both on-site and remote/office phases of the project lifecycle. It combines software commissioning, hardware coordination, database scripting, environment configuration, and formal test/sign-off responsibilities that have historically been distributed across multiple roles and a dedicated installation team.Â This position carries broadened scope following the consolidation of hardware installation and commissioning functions previously performed by a dedicated Systems Integration Commissioning (SI C) team, which has since been dissolved. The Software Deployment Engineer I/II is expected to operate as the primary and, in several functions, sole point of ownership for the responsibilities outlined below.Â Key ResponsibilitiesÂ On-Site DeliveryÂ Lead software commissioning of Kommand and peripheral hardware systems at customer sites; serve as primary technical owner, with hardware-side support from junior/peer staff.Â Own full-scope installation of pick-to-light systems, including wiring, physical installation, configuration, and functional testing â a scope absorbed from the former SI C team.Â Own full-scope installation of overhead illuminator systems, following the same end-to-end responsibility as above.Â Conduct IQ (Installation Qualification) and UAT (User Acceptance Testing) following installation, including preparation of formal test documentation and customer sign-off.Â Serve as the sole owner of Kommand and system-level troubleshooting for live, in-production issues during on-site engagements.Â Remote / Office DeliveryÂ Independently deliver new Kommand installations, including application pre-configuration, database scripting, and pre-deployment testing. Sole personnel on this workstream, currently managing 4 upcoming and 1 active installation.Â Independently deliver Kommand version upgrades, including SSDT (SQL Server Data Tools) schema comparisons, version control, local pre-install testing, and direct customer coordination. Sole personnel on this workstream, with approximately 22 major upgrades planned in the current year.Â Production upgrade execution is performed after standard business hours to minimize customer downtime.Â DEV, QA, and Sandbox environment work is performed during standard business hours.Â Validate, diagnose, and remediate reported defects; route confirmed fixes to QA prior to merge and deployment. Escalation to other engineering resources is rare.Â Participate in the on-call rotation covering Kommand, AutoStore, and T-sort system escalations.Â Provide post-go-live project support on an as-needed basis, including system migrations (e.g., bin/location migrations), integration testing with customer ERP/WMS platforms (e.g., SAP/WMS), and multi-site rollout support.Â Project Configuration DeploymentÂ Gather all Kommand configurations and system parameters required for a given project.Â Translate the Business Requirements Document (BRD) and customer conversations into the Kommand system settings spreadsheet, network spreadsheet, and system parameters.Â Educate the client on use of the host interface.Â Not required for all projects â dependent on whether the customer's integration involves interface changes (e.g., AutoCase, Pack Hold).Â Configure the client's Kommand sandbox environment to be project-specific for customer testing, and support the client through that testing.Â Configure the Kommand production environment ahead of go-live.Â Assist with training on any new features requiring customer or internal education.Â Scope IndependenceÂ This role currently operates as the sole owner of several critical workstreams, including all new Kommand installations, all Kommand upgrade delivery, and all live Kommand/system troubleshooting. The role requires the judgment and technical depth to manage customer-facing delivery, testing, and sign-off without a dedicated support team, and to make sound decisions under time pressure during after-hours production changes and live escalations.Â Demonstrated experience commissioning warehouse execution/control software and associated hardware peripherals.Â Working knowledge of SQL Server-based application environments, including SSDT schema comparison and version control practices.Â Experience with formal software testing methodology (IQ/UAT), including documentation and customer sign-off processes.Â Ability to independently diagnose, troubleshoot, and resolve live production issues under time pressure.Â Comfort with hands-on installation work (wiring, hardware configuration) for pick-to-light and overhead illumination systems, or willingness/ability to develop this competency.Â Willingness to work after hours and participate in an on-call rotation.Â Ability to translate business requirements documentation and customer conversations into structured system configuration (settings, network, and parameter specifications).Â Strong customer-facing communication skills; comfortable coordinating directly with customer stakeholders during upgrades, go-live support, and system/interface training.Â Preferred QualificationsÂ Prior experience with AutoStore and/or T-sort systems.Â Experience with ERP/WMS integration testing (e.g., SAP).Â Background in material handling, warehouse automation, or industrial controls environments.Â What we Offer: Medical Insurance Dental Insurance Vision Insurance Health Care Concierge Service 401(k) Retirement Plan (Pre-tax Roth) Company paid Basic Life Insurance, Short-Term Disability Long-Term Disability Voluntary Life AD D Insurance Voluntary Accident, Critical Illness Hospital Indemnity Insurance Pet Insurance Milk Stork Program Wellness Program with gift card redemption and wellness challenges Paid Time Off (Vacation, Sick 10 Holidays) Training Development Why KPI Solutions? At KPI Solutions, youâll be part of a team that values innovation, accountability, and continuous improvement. This is more than a reporting roleâitâs an opportunity to make a measurable impact on project success and business performance. jobs.title: (Senior or Staff) Backend Engineer, AI tooling
jobs.desc: Synthesia is the world’s leading AI video platform for business, used by over 90% of the Fortune 100. Founded in 2017, the company is headquartered in London, with offices and teams across Europe and the US. As AI continues to shape the way we live and work, Synthesia develops products to enhance visual communication and enterprise skill development, helping people work better and stay at the center of successful organizations. Following our recent Series E funding round, where we raised $200 million, our valuation stands at $4 billion. Our total funding exceeds $530 million from premier investors including Accel, NVentures (Nvidia's VC arm), Kleiner Perkins, GV, and Evantic Capital, alongside the founders and operators of Stripe, Datadog, Miro, and Webflow. About the role The Developer Platform team builds internal tools and platform that improve the velocity, quality and developer experience of Synthesia's engineering teams. They own developer productivity (from code commit to production), developer insights and SDLC metrics, developer infrastructure (CI/CD systems), AI-assisted QA/testing and AI-assisted development. AI Adoption has grown to 90%+ employees with 100%~ adoption in engineering in the last 8 months. You'll have a big surface area and real ownership from day one into making Synthesia's engineering go faster but with quality in this day and age of AI-driven development. You will work end-to-end owning the architectural decisions that govern how features are built, released safely to customers, and supported long-term. You'll mentor engineers and embed technical practice through code review and design partnership. You will lead projects that span quarters, breaking down complex problems into milestones that can be validated iteratively. You'll operate with high autonomy: defining success criteria, calling trade-offs, and knowing when to escalate to leadership. You will partner directly with leadership to shape the roadmap and technical strategy. You'll have the skills to push back on requirements, propose alternatives, and influence what we build and when. You will own the operational health of systems you build and you'll use data to drive decisions about iteration, maintenance, and deprecation. You will be accountable for the technical direction of your area. You'll anticipate 12+ month technical challenges, propose solutions that scale, and build the engineering capabilities that will let us execute ahead of the curve. What we're looking for: At least seven (7) years of experience as a software engineer, with at least 2-3 years working on senior/staff level Proven hands-on experience building and operating developer platforms, CI/CD systems, observability/metrics infrastructure, code quality automation, testing infrastructure and/or developer tooling. You have previously shipped infrastructure or tooling that measurably improved developer velocity or reduced cognitive load. Previous experience leading the adoption of new AI-powered developer tools or capabilities across an engineering organization. You have operated in a high-performing engineering organization (scale-up or established) where you've seen how infrastructure choices directly impact team velocity and product quality. You understand what it means to build for other engineers. Experience integrating third-party services (APIs, SaaS tools, external platforms) into internal systems, with attention to reliability, security, and user experience. You understand the operational constraints of running other people's code/services at scale. Clear understanding that platform and infrastructure work directly enables commercial outcomes. Previous experience owning large technical areas end-to-end. Why join us? We’re living the golden age of AI. The next decade will yield the next iconic companies, and we dare to say we have what it takes to become one. Here’s why, Our culture At Synthesia we’re passionate about building, not talking, planning or politicising. We strive to hire the smartest, kindest and most unrelenting people and let them do their best work without distractions. Our work principles serve as our charter for how we make decisions, give feedback and structure our work to empower everyone to go as fast as possible. You can find out more about these principles here. Serving 50,000+ customers (and 90% of the Fortune 100) We’re trusted by leading brands such as Heineken, Zoom, Xerox, McDonald’s and more. Read stories from happy customers and what 1,200+ people say on G2 . Proprietary AI technology Since 2017, we’ve been pioneering advancements in Generative AI. Our AI technology is built in-house, by a team of world-class AI researchers and engineers. Learn more about our AI Research Lab and the team behind. AI Safety, Ethics and Security AI safety, ethics, and security are fundamental to our mission. While the full scope of Artificial Intelligence's impact on our society is still unfolding, our position is clear: People first. Always. Learn more about our commitments to AI Ethics, Safety Security . The hiring process: 30-40min call with our Technical Recruiter 45min call with an Engineering Manager about your past projects 90min Product Discovery/Implementation, a collaboration exercise with our Engineer (not Leetcode style, in Python). 60min System Design, technical discussion usually about a real problem we had in production. 60min call with leadership, focus on examples of collaboration, growth and going through details of your future team. You can find more details on what to expect and how to prepare HERE . The pace of the process depends on your availability. Other important info: Our preference is for this role to based either in-office or remote in the following locations: UK, Germany, Switzerland or Ireland. We may also be able to support remote workers in other locations across Europe subject to compliance and right to work checks. The salary starts at EUR/GBP/CHF 130.000 base + equity (RSUs). This is full-time employment only - no contractors possible - usually through OysterHR. Everyone at Synthesia gets 25 days of leave + local holidays ( no extra paid or unpaid leave possible ). jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Quality
jobs.desc: Camunda is the enterprise platform for agentic orchestration , enabling organizations to coordinate AI agents, people, and systems across complex, end-to-end business processes. With built-in governance, auditability, and human oversight, Camunda gives enterprises the control they need to move AI from pilots to production — safely and at scale. Trusted by over 700 organizations worldwide , including 9 of top 10 US banks, Camunda helps enterprises boost operational efficiency, accelerate time-to-value, and deliver better customer experiences. Fully remote and global, we are in the middle of something bigger: transforming into an AI-first organisation, built on our own platform . We use Agentic AI to automate, orchestrate intelligent processes, and elevate human contribution across every team. Named GP Bullhound’s Top 100 Next Unicorn list, 2025 Great Place to Work certified. Visionary in 2025 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Business Orchestration and Automation Technologies. ranked 3rd in Flexa's 2026 Most Flexible Companies , We’re growing fast and looking for top talent to join our team. If you want meaningful work, visible impact and put something genuinely rare on your CV, keep reading. About the role: We're hiring a Senior Software Engineer, Quality to build the agentic layer of how Camunda tests its software. We treat quality as an engineering discipline. We build test infrastructure the way we build our product — real design decisions, real trade-offs, real ownership. What's changing is how that work gets done: we're moving from hand-written test suites toward agents that design, generate, maintain and triage tests across the lifecycle. We need someone to build both the agents and the infrastructure that makes them dependable, and to help shape our Quality AI strategy. You'll support product teams that ship features without dedicated QA. Your job is not to become their testing safety net. It's to build the tooling and practices that let builders own quality themselves — and to stay close enough to real features to know where that tooling breaks.
